outbox.title: SMTP outbox

outbox.scope: Sending is manual only. Saved content and recipients remain unchanged; a new draft requires its own review. This workflow does not include attachments.
outbox.budget: Technical transport budget: up to 1 MiB for the complete MIME message and at most 60 seconds per attempt. Adjust oversized content or split it into separately reviewed messages; nothing is truncated.

outbox.acceptedHint: The SMTP server accepted this message, or acceptance was resolved by a documented decision. This does not confirm delivery to the recipient.
outbox.unknownHint: DATA acceptance is unknown. There is no automatic retry. Check the previous attempt with the SMTP provider and document the decision. A deliberate retry may produce a duplicate message.
outbox.claimedHint: This attempt is claimed. Its state can be checked once the lease expires; checking sends nothing.
outbox.confirmSend: Send this unchanged reviewed content through the configured SMTP server now?
outbox.confirmRecover: Check the expired attempt? Possible DATA acceptance still requires human resolution. Nothing is sent.
outbox.confirmDecision: Save this documented decision? Approving another attempt does not send it; a later retry may duplicate a message whose acceptance is unknown.

bankImport.invalidHint: No booking was published. Correct the file or column mapping and check again; all errors can be paged through.
bankImport.confirmQuestion: Publish all checked bookings together now? Proven repeats will not be created again. Payments and matching remain separate actions.
bankImport.memoryHint: This installation uses temporary memory storage. Durable import history requires persistent SQL storage.
bankImport.invalidResponse: The import response could not be verified. Reload the saved state.

accountBalance.title: Trace account balance
accountBalance.description: Review the opening amount together with stored bank transactions. This view does not change account values.
accountBalance.invalidResponse: The balance evidence could not be read completely. Please reload.
accountBalance.chooseHint: Select an account to review its stored evidence.
accountBalance.undatedNote: The opening amount and manual comparison balance have no reference date. A cutoff therefore does not establish a verified historical bank reconciliation. A difference requires review.
accountBalance.allStored: All stored transactions, including future dates
accountBalance.blocked: Invalid evidence prevents calculation. Review and correct the listed issues, then reload.
accountBalance.statusNote: Every stored bank transaction counts once. Status classifies a transaction; it is not a reversal record. Payments and receivables are not added separately.
accountBalance.noIssues: No invalid amount evidence found. This does not confirm agreement with the bank.
accountBalance.noBookings: No bank transactions are stored for this period.

issue.amount_fractional_cent: Amount contains fractions of a cent
issue.amount_capacity: Amount exceeds the stored field’s capacity

repair.edit_account: Review the account values and correct the amount to valid cents. Contact management if you cannot edit it.
repair.edit_booking: Review and correct the transaction by its ID in transaction management. Contact management if you cannot edit it.

accountBalance.sourceCaption: Stored evidence ordered by date and ID, ascending
accountBalance.comparisonTotalHint: This total shows manually maintained comparison values with no reference date. Calculated balances are read on demand from each account’s bank transactions.
accountBalance.validAccountAmounts: Enter both finite, cent-exact amounts within the account fields’ capacity.

workflow.title: Contract assistant
workflow.description: Select parties and property, save a draft, review it and explicitly publish.
workflow.noCash: The deposit is agreed only. No cash receipt, bank booking or executed direct debit is created.
workflow.rentHint: Preview uses the saved unit amounts. Describe special stepped/index rules in reviewed own terms; the separate builder provides the full clause workflow.
workflow.handover: Prepare unconfirmed move-in handover draft (no keys / signatures)
workflow.immutableVersion: Each save creates an immutable version. Previously reviewed contracts keep their original version.
workflow.termsPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the selected template version.
workflow.termsHint: Own text replaces template text for this contract. Review all content and specifics before publishing.
workflow.attachmentHint: Local originals are archived immutably with SHA256 and size. External or unavailable files require explicit metadata-only confirmation.
workflow.metadataOnly: Explicit metadata-only link — no original bytes
workflow.unsavedChanges: Save changes first, then review again.
workflow.publishConfirm: Create this reviewed version in the management system? New tenant (if selected), contract, document and optional handover draft are created together. No payment is booked.
workflow.publishedHint: This reviewed version and its PDF remain immutable. Continue contract management from the contract overview.
workflow.manualHint: Signatures are recorded as explicitly confirmed manual administrative evidence. No electronic signature verification or automatic activation.
workflow.signedDocument: Optional signature document for this contract
workflow.signatureConfirm: Confirm manually reviewed signature with date, parties and evidence reference? This does not activate the contract.
workflow.malformed: The server response or file is incomplete. No successful publication or download has been confirmed.
workflow.switchConfirm: Discard unsaved input and open another version?
workflow.uncertain: The response may have been lost. Retry the exact same command; no duplicate contract objects are created.
workflow.transient: This store is temporary. Persistent resume and backups require SQL storage.

bankMatching.title: Allocate bank booking
bankMatching.help: Suggestions support your review. Deliberately select the correct open item; importing a file does not create payments.
bankMatching.readonly: You can view suggestions and receipts. Booking permissions are required to confirm or reverse.
bankMatching.ambiguous: Several items are equally plausible. Check the reference, due date and amount; no suggestion is selected.
bankMatching.empty: No matching open items. Change the search or item type and review again.
bankMatching.fullyAllocated: This bank booking is fully allocated.
bankMatching.invoiceBalanceHelp: Recorded paid amounts may include carried-over balances. The receipt list shows the payment receipts actually recorded.
bankMatching.confirmQuestion: Allocate this bank booking to the selected open item for the chosen amount?
bankMatching.confirmHelp: A receipt is created using the bank booking date. No additional bank movement is created.
bankMatching.invalidResponse: The response is incomplete or belongs to a different selection. Please review again.
bankMatching.invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places within the open amount and bank budget.
bankMatching.historyHelp: Original receipts remain after reversal. Credit payouts appear in the credit journal and also consume the bank budget.
bankMatching.noHistory: No payment receipts are stored for this selection.
bankMatching.reverseConfirm: Reverse this payment receipt and reopen the amount?
bankMatching.reverseHelp: Reversal reopens the item and releases the bank budget. The original receipt and bank booking are retained.
bankMatching.invoiceNavigationHelp: Choose an actual outgoing bank booking for this invoice and review the allocation.

reasons.amount_exact: Open amount equals available bank amount
reasons.same_portfolio: Account and item belong to the same portfolio
reasons.unassigned_property: Bank booking has no assigned property
reasons.partial_payment: Bank amount permits a partial payment

formDraft.title: Private form draft
formDraft.restoreHint: An earlier draft is available. Current form values are replaced only after your explicit choice.
formDraft.pendingRestore: The earlier save was started. Its outcome is not confirmed here. Check the current records first so that you do not create an already saved record again.
formDraft.schemaChanged: This form has changed. The draft cannot be safely restored automatically. You may explicitly discard it.
formDraft.storageHint: Only form values are encrypted for your user account. No file bytes, passwords or payment execution. The business record changes only when you choose Save.
formDraft.failed: The draft could not be saved. Your current form values are retained.
formDraft.invalidResponse: Draft storage did not return a valid saved revision.
formDraft.uncertain: The save outcome is uncertain. Check current records before trying again.
formDraft.cleanupHint: Cleaning up the form draft does not change the saved record. Do not repeat the business save.

status.restored: Draft restored · business record not saved yet

documentsOCR.originalSaved: The original was uploaded successfully and is retained. You can still save the document details.

corrections.budget: Reduce the resolution or split the document. An administrator can review the OCR budget named in the error.
corrections.timeout: Split the document or ask an administrator to review the OCR time budget. Retry uses the saved original.
corrections.setup: An administrator must check tool paths and installed language data; images also require Pillow.
corrections.original: Check the original file. Save images again as PNG/JPEG or split the PDF if needed.
corrections.worker: An administrator should check local OCR tools and available operating system resources.

contractLifecycle.title: Renewal or termination
contractLifecycle.malformed: The server response does not match the expected contract workflow. Reload the current state.
contractLifecycle.loadFailed: The contract workflow could not be loaded.
contractLifecycle.writeDenied: Write access is no longer available.
contractLifecycle.stale: The contract state changed. Reload and review again.
contractLifecycle.commandFailed: The contract command could not be saved.
contractLifecycle.noDrafts: No open drafts owned by you.
contractLifecycle.deliberateUnlimited: Deliberately create the successor without an end date
contractLifecycle.supersedesTitle: This operation supersedes an earlier termination
contractLifecycle.obligationsWarning: Existing receivables or rent periods need attention. This operation does not delete or recalculate them.
contractLifecycle.keepObligations: Existing financial evidence, receivables and payments remain unchanged.
contractLifecycle.manualNotice: No automatic delivery or legal validity is asserted. Deadlines and communication remain subject to manual review.
contractLifecycle.confirmChecked: I have deliberately reviewed the data, review and warnings.
contractLifecycle.confirmRequired: Explicitly confirm that you reviewed the result.
contractLifecycle.unsavedChanges: The inputs changed. Save the draft and review the result again before confirming.
contractLifecycle.confirmPrompt: Explicitly confirm this reviewed contract operation now?
contractLifecycle.noHistory: No confirmed contract lifecycle record yet.
contractLifecycle.pendingFinalize: The confirmed end is in the future or still requires manual completion.
contractLifecycle.finalizePrompt: Manually finalize the termination after its confirmed end now?
contractLifecycle.supersededNoFinalize: This operation was superseded and can no longer be finalized.
contractLifecycle.disclaimer: This interface records a manual management workflow; it sends no declarations and provides no legal guarantee.
contractLifecycle.renewal_required: New contract number and start date are required.
contractLifecycle.end_choice_required: Provide an end date or explicitly choose open-ended.
contractLifecycle.notFinalizable: This operation cannot be finalized in its current state.

contractWorkspace.description: Search, review and manage contracts within your current access.
contractWorkspace.invalidResult: The contract data is incomplete or invalid. Please reload.
contractWorkspace.missingReference: The selected relationship is no longer available. Please reload and review it.
contractWorkspace.search: Find contract, property, unit or tenant
contractWorkspace.pageSummary: On this page: {{count}} contracts · {{active}} active · {{ending}} ending within 90 days
contractWorkspace.unitRentHint: The displayed cold rent comes from current unit data. Effective rent adjustments and historical charges are shown in the rent account.
contractWorkspace.smallPage: Start with one contract per page

contractCorrespondence.title: Contract correspondence
contractCorrespondence.policy: Dates and letters are entered and reviewed explicitly. Notice-period text is not used to calculate legal deadlines; this record confirms no legal validity and sends nothing.
contractCorrespondence.invalidResponse: The response does not match this contract or contains incomplete evidence. Reload and check the records.
contractCorrespondence.invalidDownload: The response is not a valid PDF. Nothing was downloaded.
contractCorrespondence.completeFields: Complete the dates, basis, recipient, subject and text or template, and confirm the management date.
contractCorrespondence.unknown: The outcome is unknown. The exact command is retained; retry it with the same operation reference.
contractCorrespondence.reloadConflict: Load current records · keep entered values
contractCorrespondence.noDrafts: No letter drafts of your own.
contractCorrespondence.requiresReview: The sources changed. Review open drafts again; approved letters remain unchanged. Another dispatch requires a new reviewed approval. Receipt of an existing recorded dispatch can still be recorded.
contractCorrespondence.smallPages: Retry with the smallest page size
contractCorrespondence.deadlineConfirmed: I reviewed this management date and its basis myself.
contractCorrespondence.subject: Subject
contractCorrespondence.unsaved: The entered values differ from the saved draft. Save them explicitly before review or approval.
contractCorrespondence.approveConsent: I reviewed this exact version, the recipient and the management date and explicitly approve them.
contractCorrespondence.consentRequired: Explicitly confirm the exact reviewed version shown.
contractCorrespondence.documentPermission: Approval creates an immutable document and also requires document write permission. Drafting and review remain available.
contractCorrespondence.approvePrompt: Save this exact reviewed letter as an immutable document? This sends nothing.
contractCorrespondence.immutable: This approval and its original remain unchanged. Changes require a new letter.
contractCorrespondence.eventsPolicy: Record only events actually observed. Saving a record does not send anything or confirm legally effective delivery.
contractCorrespondence.noEvents: No dispatch or receipt records yet.
contractCorrespondence.eventConsent: I confirm this event actually occurred and the related evidence.
contractCorrespondence.eventRequired: Enter the event date, evidence reference and note; for receipt choose a recorded dispatch and explicitly confirm all values.
contractCorrespondence.eventPrompt: Record this actually observed event immutably? Nothing is sent.
contractCorrespondence.savedTemplate: Saved template version outside this page
contractCorrespondence.templatePolicy: Templates are your own immutable text versions, not legal review. A new version preserves every earlier version.
contractCorrespondence.placeholders: Available placeholders: {{contract_number}}, {{tenant_name}}, {{property_name}}, {{unit_label}}, {{start_date}}, {{end_date}}, {{deadline_date}}, {{deadline_basis}}, {{recipient_name}}, {{recipient_address}}. Other placeholders are rejected during review.
contractCorrespondence.saveTemplateConfirm: Save this new template version immutably? Earlier versions are retained.
contractCorrespondence.usePredecessor: Use selected version as predecessor · keep edited text
